use_fvg      = input.bool(true, "Enable Fair Value Gap (FVG) Confirmation", group=grp_smc)

grp_momentum = "Oscillators & Volume Regime"
rsi_len      = input.int(14, "RSI Calculation Length", minval=2, group=grp_momentum)
rsi_long_min = input.int(45, "RSI Long Minimum (Expansion Gate)", minval=30, maxval=70, group=grp_momentum)
rsi_long_max = input.int(65, "RSI Long Maximum (Overbought Gate)", minval=50, maxval=90, group=grp_momentum)
rsi_short_min= input.int(32, "RSI Short Minimum (Oversold Gate)", minval=10, maxval=50, group=grp_momentum)
rsi_short_max= input.int(55, "RSI Short Maximum (Compression Gate)", minval=30, maxval=70, group=grp_momentum)
mfi_len      = input.int(14, "Money Flow Index (MFI) Length", minval=5, group=grp_momentum)
vol_mult     = input.float(1.35, "Institutional Volume Multiplier", minval=1.0, step=0.05, group=grp_momentum)

tp_pct_raw   = input.float(3.5, "Underlying Take-Profit %", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_futures)
sl_pct_raw   = input.float(1.5, "Underlying Stop-Loss %", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_futures)
atr_len      = input.int(14, "ATR Volatility Period", minval=5, group=grp_futures)
atr_sl_mult  = input.float(1.5, "ATR Trailing Stop Multiplier", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_futures)

vol_ma  = ta.sma(volume, 20)

ema_50  = ta.ema(close, 50)
ema_200 = ta.ema(close, 200)

highest_high = ta.highest(high, ob_len)
lowest_low   = ta.lowest(low, ob_len)

bearish_sweep = high > highest_high[1] and close < highest_high[1] and vol_surge

bearish_fvg = use_fvg and (high < low[2])

bear_momentum = (rsi_v <= rsi_short_max and rsi_v >= rsi_short_min) and (mfi_v <= 50.0)

trend_bearish = close < ema_20 and ema_20 < ema_50

short_condition = (bearish_sweep or (bearish_fvg and trend_bearish)) and bear_momentum and ta.crossunder(close, ema_20)

    strategy.entry("SMC_5X_LONG", strategy.long, alert_message=alert_json)

if (short_condition and strategy.position_size == 0)
    short_sl_price := close * (1.0 + (sl_pct_raw / 100.0))
    short_tp_price := close * (1.0 - (tp_pct_raw / 100.0))

rsi_short_min= input.int(32, "RSI Short Minimum (Oversold Gate)", minval=10, maxval=50, group=grp_momentum)

tp_pct_raw   = input.float(3.5, "Underlying Take-Profit %", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_futures)
sl_pct_raw   = input.float(1.5, "Underlying Stop-Loss %", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_futures)
atr_len      = input.int(14, "ATR Volatility Period", minval=5, group=grp_futures)
atr_sl_mult  = input.float(1.5, "ATR Trailing Stop Multiplier", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_futures)

rsi_v   = ta.rsi(close, rsi_len)
mfi_v   = ta.mfi(hlc3, volume, mfi_len)

ema_50  = ta.ema(close, 50)
ema_200 = ta.ema(close, 200)

highest_high = ta.highest(high, ob_len)
lowest_low   = ta.lowest(low, ob_len)

bearish_sweep = high > highest_high[1] and close < highest_high[1] and vol_surge

bearish_fvg = use_fvg and (high < low[2])

bear_momentum = (rsi_v <= rsi_short_max and rsi_v >= rsi_short_min) and (mfi_v <= 50.0)

trend_bearish = close < ema_20 and ema_20 < ema_50

    strategy.entry("SMC_5X_LONG", strategy.long, alert_message=alert_json)

    short_tp_price := close * (1.0 - (tp_pct_raw / 100.0))
